configurations.//: B-04 (audit-runs/audit2.md). This served the REPO ROOT: -t . put data/, admin/config.local.php (the live password hash), admin/admin-log.jsonl, admin/inquiries.jsonl and _localsite/ on http://localhost with no .htaccess in force, because PHP's built-in server ignores .htaccess entirely. It also hardcoded C:\php\php.exe, so it could only ever run on one Windows machine. The docroot below is the one _harness/README.md documents and the one every admin suite uses; run `npm run build && sh _harness/sync.sh` first to populate it.
configurations.name: php-admin (harness mirror)
